text:
mara: Quick poll — snack showdown for this week's standup lunch? Vote with emoji or reply. Options: :apple: apples, :pretzel: pretzels, :chocolate_bar: chocolate bar. I'll order whatever's winning by 1pm. Also note any dietary needs.
kevin: Chocolate all the way :chocolate_bar: 
ana: Pretzels please :pretzel: (glad we're not doing another mystery salad)
jordan: Apple for me, trying to be healthy :apple: 
eli: Chocolate but can we get a gluten-free option for the team member who's allergic? :chocolate_bar:
sara: Pretzels + hummus sounds better than chips tbh :pretzel: :yum:
mara: Noted on GF. If chocolate wins I'll try to get GF bars + a pretzel backup.
kevin: Also can someone grab napkins this time? Last week was a paper towel situation :sweat_smile:
mara: Good call. I'll add napkins to the order command: `/order-snacks --items chocolate,napkins --location HQ --by 1pm`
lunchbot: Poll created by mara — reacts to vote or reply. Current tallies: apples (1), pretzels (2), chocolate (2). Poll closes at 12:30.
ana: Ooh looks tight — tie-breaker idea: whoever brings homemade cookies gets veto :joy:
jordan: remote folks: will you want a Venmo for snacks or skip this round? @eli
eli: I can Venmo for remote pickup if needed.
mara: If pretzels win I'll do a second pack for the remote folks (ship by courier).
kevin: Chocolate still my vote but I'm fine with whatever. :thumbsup:
sara: Pretzels final vote from me. +1 for hummus if lunch budget allows.
lunchbot: Final results (12:31): apples 1, pretzels 3, chocolate 2. Pretzels win! Ordering now. Receipt will be posted in #finance-expenses. :pretzel:
mara: Pretzels it is. Thanks everyone! Remind me if anyone needs GF option and I'll order a small GF snack pack. :heart:
